name: Only the tools the step needs
description: The tools the task names were called and the ones it forbids were not. A question runs no workflow; an alert never executes an action that needs approval.

name: Routed the recipe's way
description: Triage first; threat intel before the investigation for IOC matches and phishing, after it for EDR detections; the playbook after both; the incident opened last.

name: No tool errored
description: Every lookup returned. The feature store is where this agent fails quietly.

name: Explained its role
description: Asked what it does, the orchestrator describes the workflow and asks for raw alert text; it runs nothing.

describes_the_workflow.description: The reply says it triages alerts, checks indicators against threat intelligence, investigates logs, proposes a playbook, and holds disruptive actions for approval.

asks_for_an_alert.description: The reply asks the analyst to paste raw alert text, naming the kinds it takes (EDR detection, IOC match, phishing report).

did_nothing.description: Nothing was triaged, looked up or opened.

name: Reported the incident end to end
description: Judges the report against the task's rubric: the classification, the threat named, the playbook, what waits for approval, the incident opened, and the JSON log.

matches_the_rubric.description: The report says what the task's rubric says it should: the alert type, the threat the intelligence named, the playbook chosen, and whether approval is required.

step_by_step.description: The report walks through triage, threat intelligence, investigation and response in that order, with the findings of each, and names the incident id opened.

json_log.description: The report ends with a JSON block holding alert_type, entities, triage, threat_intel, investigation, recommended_actions, incident_id and hitl_approval_required.

nothing_invented.description: Every finding in the report appears in a tool result; no threat, host, process or connection is added from general knowledge.

name: The conversation got there
description: Judges the whole exchange against the task's rubric: what should have happened by the end, and what must not have.

did_what_the_rubric_says.description: By the end of the conversation the agent did what the task's rubric describes and did not do what it says must not happen.

said_so_plainly.description: Each turn's reply states what was done in that turn, and nothing more: a duplicate is reported as one, an approval confirms exactly the actions that ran.
